annotations.title: Find the best drillhole intercepts near a point

description: The best downhole intercepts ("8 m @ 2.1 g/t Au from 120 m") in the drillholes around a point, from the company assays the data map's 3D view draws, by one stated rule: a run starts and ends on a sample at or above the cut-off, holds at most max_dilution_m metres in a row below it (unsampled gaps count as zero), keeps a length-weighted grade at or above it, and is at least min_width_m long. The default cut-off is the hub's (0.5 g/t Au, 5 g/t Ag, 0.1 % Cu, 0.5 % Ni, 0.5 % Zn, 0.3 % Li2O, ...). Returns the rule, how many holes were looked at and assayed for the element, the intercepts best first (grade x width) with each hole's name, type, year, operator, WAMEX report and collar, and a link to the 3D view coloured by the element. Computed from reported assays; not a resource estimate.

cutoff_ppm.description: The cut-off in ppm (1 ppm = 1 g/t; 1 % = 10,000 ppm).
